en.answer: In the proposed scenario, since <<12002>> has been destroyed by the time its effect resolves, the effect that Special Summons a monster does not resolve.
en.question: If <<4909>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<12002>> , so that <<12002>> is destroyed, how does this resolve?
